# Code of Conduct

## Our Standards

We are committed to a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free environment.

**Expected behavior:**
- Be respectful and constructive in all communications
- Welcome newcomers and help them get oriented
- Accept constructive feedback gracefully
- Focus on what is best for the project and community

**Unacceptable behavior:**
- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks
- Discriminatory language or imagery
- Publishing private information without consent
- Any conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement

Violations may be reported to casjay@yahoo.com. All reports are reviewed confidentially. Maintainers will take appropriate action, up to and including permanent bans.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in all project spaces (GitHub issues, PRs, discussions) and in public spaces when representing the project.
